title: Reconcile production documentation and readiness contracts
body:
## Summary
- reconcile architecture, deployment, security, dataset, and ADR documentation with the verified production runtime
- preserve historical ADRs and add explicit superseding decisions for the lightweight CV and Railway PostgreSQL production paths
- update release readiness checks to use the runtime model paths and canonical `data/evaluation` artifacts
- require schema `public`, model version `cv-lightweight-1`, reviewed Gemini metrics, MobileNetV3/YOLO class contracts, and checkpoint/provenance checksum agreement
- add regression tests for current readiness, stale schema/tampering, and container-relative model paths

## Verification
- `PYTHONPATH=. ../.venv/bin/pytest -q` — 30 passed
- `python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py`
- `git diff --check`
- readiness checker exercised with the actual `cv-lightweight-1` release binaries; both SHA-256 values matched committed provenance and secret values were not emitted

## Scope
Draft only. No merge, deployment, Railway, PostgreSQL, Supabase, domains, or secrets were touched.

title: Record synthetic-controlled CV evaluation and adaptation
body:
## Summary
- document the audited synthetic-controlled baseline evaluation
- document the single controlled adaptation experiment and its mixed outcome
- refresh the model card to match the current MobileNetV3 + YOLO11n-seg production pipeline
- explicitly distinguish all-image metrics from damaged-only metrics
- keep synthetic-generated evidence separate from genuine-camera validation
- record that the adapted checkpoint is not deployment-ready and remains undeployed

No production runtime code, Railway configuration, database resources, secrets, or deployed model are changed.

title: Record verified production E2E smoke pass
body:
## Summary
- record the verified live production E2E checkpoint in README/finalization/checklist
- document the exact deployed application SHA and successful smoke run
- explicitly preserve the distinction between this public-pilot production smoke and the still-pending project-controlled real-data evaluation

No runtime code, Railway configuration, database resource, or deployment path is changed.

title: Harden production smoke against Gemini transport timeouts
body:
## Summary
- keep Gemini as an exercised but non-blocking third-party dependency in the production E2E smoke
- tolerate only transport timeout/connection failures around the optional AI-review call
- preserve failures for unexpected HTTP contract errors
- continue to final persisted-case and CV audit assertions after a provider timeout
- retrigger the production smoke after merge

## Why
The latest backend fix is live and the production smoke now proves the immediate `/inspect` response contains persisted CV evidence. The remaining smoke failure was a client-side 180s timeout while Gemini experienced intermittent provider 503s; Railway completed the same AI-review request successfully shortly afterward. This patch makes the workflow match its documented intent without weakening CV/persistence checks.

title: Fix production smoke rerun case ID collision
body:
## Summary
- include `GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` in production smoke QA case IDs
- prevents rerunning the same workflow run from colliding with the prior persisted QA case
- retrigger the production E2E smoke after merge

## Context
The backend refresh fix is now live on Railway at `fa15d51cabafd1f2afc02517e9562fc6d383df75`. The rerun reached the live health/readiness/metrics checks successfully, but failed before CV inspection because the old smoke used only `GITHUB_RUN_ID`, producing an HTTP 409 duplicate case on attempt 2.

No runtime application behavior or infrastructure is changed by this PR.

title: Clarify CV evidence refresh behavior
body: Documentation-only backend comment update. This also provides a fresh backend-path push after correcting Railway watch-pattern syntax so the existing returnreview-api service can pick up the already-merged inspection-response fix from main. No schema, API contract, or infrastructure changes.

title: Refresh CV evidence in inspection response
body: Fixes the only failure found by the live production E2E smoke. CV inference itself completed successfully, but the immediate `/inspect` response serialized stale SQLAlchemy relationships because `expire_on_commit=False`; a fresh GET already sees the persisted inspection. Expiring the session after the CV commit makes the same response truthful immediately. Adds a regression test that would fail before this fix. No schema or infrastructure change.

title: Add production end-to-end smoke test
body: Adds a non-production-changing GitHub Actions smoke test for the now-deployed ReturnReview stack. It verifies live health/readiness/metrics, confirms the Evaluation page renders both LLM and CV sections, downloads two held-out licensed Roboflow test images, creates a clearly labeled QA case, uploads two views, runs the live lightweight CV inspection, exercises Gemini review when provider capacity permits, and verifies the persisted audit timeline. Only `.github/**` changes are included, so this does not trigger another Railway app rebuild.

title: Integrate validated lightweight CV runtime
body: Production-safe CV runtime integration for the validated `cv-lightweight-1` release. Replaces runtime OpenCLIP with MobileNetV3-Small category verification, uses multiclass YOLO outputs for defect typing, maps source squeeze damage to `crushed_corner` vs `dent_or_crush` with an explicit corner-geometry heuristic, pins 320px CPU inference, publishes the real held-out public-pilot CV metrics, updates the Evaluation dashboard, adds checksum-verified Docker packaging, and adds regression/container checks. The recorded 1 GB Railway capacity gate passes (~894.7 MB estimated API+CV footprint with reserve). The user explicitly approved finishing the remaining project steps on 2026-09-26. Project-controlled cardboard-box capture remains a separate academic evidence task and is not fabricated.

title: Train lightweight production CV candidate
body: Replaces the production OpenCLIP dependency with a lower-memory design suitable for the current 1 GB Railway API: multiclass YOLO11n-seg handles damage classes and a MobileNetV3-Small binary classifier verifies cardboard-box category. Adds leakage-safe dataset preparation, held-out evaluation, combined runtime benchmarking, a hard Railway memory gate, and immutable release packaging. This PR only adds training/evaluation tooling; it does not change Railway production runtime or variables.

title: Audit CV runtime against Railway memory limit
body: Adds an isolated component benchmark so we can decide whether ReturnReview CV can fit safely in the existing 1 GB Railway API, use a lighter OpenCLIP model, or require a separately governed inference service. It benchmarks YOLO, the current ViT-B-32 OpenCLIP model, and an RN50 candidate in separate processes, then compares their peaks against the observed ~92 MB API base memory plus a safety reserve. No production variables or Railway resources are changed.

title: Run full public CV pilot and benchmark production capacity
body: Final pre-production CV pilot pass. Uses the full licensed public train/validation/test splits instead of small subsets, adds a train-only public leakage prototype for the runtime unknown class, keeps crushed_corner as an explicit text fallback because no direct public label exists, and records combined YOLO+OpenCLIP CPU peak RSS/latency for the Railway 1 GB deployment gate. No Railway production configuration is changed by this PR.

title: Improve CV public pilot quality
body: Uses the first successful public-pilot metrics as a baseline and strengthens the actual CV model instead of deploying weak results. Increases segmentation training data/epochs/resolution and replaces text-only tear/dent prototypes with train-only OpenCLIP image prototypes; crushed_corner remains an explicitly documented text fallback because the public source has no direct label. Validation/test leakage boundaries remain unchanged. The trigger file causes the improved pilot to rerun automatically after merge.

title: Fix CV pilot checkpoint path
body: The first public CV pilot run successfully downloaded/validated data and trained YOLO, but Ultralytics resolved the relative project path under its own internal runs directory, so the workflow's checkpoint existence check failed. This resolves both the dataset and training project paths to absolute repository paths and adds the training trigger file so the corrected workflow reruns automatically after merge. No dataset labels, model hyperparameters, secrets, or runtime infrastructure are changed.

title: Add reproducible public-data CV pilot pipeline
body: Builds the remaining CV work into a reproducible, auditable pipeline without fabricating project-controlled data. Fixes the YOLO export-layout mismatch, adds deterministic segmentation subsetting, semantic OpenCLIP prototype generation, leakage-preserving calibration/test-set creation, category and defect threshold calibration/evaluation, CV metric assembly, regression tests, and a gated GitHub Actions workflow that trains/evaluates a public-data pilot only when a private Roboflow key is present. The workflow publishes a prerelease candidate with checkpoint, prototype bank, thresholds, checksums, metrics, and provenance. It does not mark the separate 28-image project-controlled capture as complete.

title: Harden grounding guard from human review findings
body: Fixes the two weaknesses discovered by the approved six-case Gemini review without rewriting the historical evaluation. The current guard now inspects uncertainty/missing-information text, flags confidence-as-complementary-uncertainty claims, and deterministically normalizes failed category verification to `insufficient_evidence`. The Gemini system prompt is tightened accordingly, regression tests cover both cases, and docs/UI explain that the published baseline metric remains historical until a future real rerun.

title: Finalize human-reviewed Gemini metrics
body: Completes the approved human-review gate for the preserved six-case Gemini run without altering the raw output. Adds a separate reviewed JSONL with audit notes, publishes the canonical LLM metrics artifact, makes CI revalidate/recompute it, serves the real metrics from the API, updates the Evaluation dashboard, adds endpoint coverage, and updates project status docs. CV metrics remain explicitly pending real training; no fake CV numbers are introduced.

title: Sync Gemini production status documentation
body: Updates stale README and secure-activation text to match the verified production state: Gemini is active on the backend, 3.8 Flash remains primary, 3.5 Flash is the capacity fallback, the real six-case run is preserved, and only its human-review gate remains for LLM metrics. No runtime or infrastructure changes.

title: Make Gemini evaluation observable and quota-safe
body: Hardens the controlled Gemini evaluation and live fallback path after the real Railway run. Daily free-tier quota exhaustion is no longer retried as if it were transient, but it can still trigger the configured production fallback. Evaluation rows are written incrementally so partial real results are preserved if a later case fails, and child progress/errors stream directly to Railway logs instead of being hidden until process exit. Adds regression coverage for hard quota fallback behavior. No database, frontend, or unrelated infrastructure changes.

title: Preserve real Gemini evaluation run
body: Preserves the exact non-secret six-case Gemini evaluation output produced in Railway, records its model and reproducibility hashes, and updates status docs. All rows remain explicitly `manual_reviewed=false`; no final metrics are claimed before human review.

title: Add truthful Gemini capacity fallback
body: Keeps the current primary Gemini model, adds a separately configured fallback used only after transient capacity/server retries are exhausted, records the actual model used by the live agent, and allows the controlled evaluation to use an explicitly named model. Includes fallback behavior tests and documentation.

title: Retry transient Gemini capacity failures
body: Keeps Gemini 3.8 Flash as the primary production model while adding bounded exponential-style backoff for transient 429/5xx failures in both the live review agent and fixed evaluation runner. Non-transient errors such as auth failures are not retried. Extends the one-time evaluation timeout to accommodate backoff and adds regression coverage.

title: Fix Gemini structured review schema
body: Real Gemini evaluation reached the structured-output path but failed because `visual_findings` used a free-form dict schema that Gemini rejects as `additionalProperties`. This replaces it with a typed `ReviewVisualFinding`, updates the grounding guard to use typed fields, and adds a regression test. No database, frontend, or infrastructure changes.

title: Add controlled Railway Gemini evaluation runner
body: Adds an opt-in, disabled-by-default background runner for the existing fixed Gemini evaluation set. It uses the already-private Railway key, never exposes it, writes non-secret results inside the running API container, and leaves every row explicitly unreviewed until a human inspects it. Also copies existing scripts into the API image. No CV behavior, database schema, frontend, or unrelated infrastructure changes.

title: Mark Railway persistence proof complete
body: Records the completed production persistence proof using PERSISTENCE-PROOF-01: case creation, two image uploads, successful API redeploy, and post-redeploy survival of case/images/audit timeline. No runtime infrastructure changes.

title: Fix image upload form reset error
body: Fixes the `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'reset')` error seen after successful image uploads. The form element is captured before awaiting the API/refresh calls, so reset no longer relies on React event currentTarget after the async boundary. No backend, database, or infrastructure changes.

title: Record verified Railway Postgres health
body: Records the successful production migration state: API startup on PostgreSQL, durable persistence enabled, and passing health/readiness. Keeps the cross-redeploy case+image proof explicitly incomplete.

title: Document Railway Postgres production persistence
body: Updates ReturnReview documentation and safety contracts so the dedicated Railway Postgres service + volume inside the isolated ReturnReview project are the intended production persistence target. Retains the prior Supabase App 13 foundation as inactive history. Does not delete or modify Supabase resources. Persistence remains incomplete until health/readiness and redeploy survival are verified.

title: Reconcile fixed Gemini evaluation onto current main
body: Reconciles the useful, non-stale parts of PR #13 onto the current main without merging its divergent branch. Keeps the canonical JSONL evaluation design, adds the missing dent_or_crush scenario, records reproducibility metadata, requires explicit human review before scoring, reports required-tool coverage, and updates evaluation/finalization docs. No production secrets, Railway configuration, Supabase data, CV taxonomy, or runtime infrastructure are changed.

title: Harden CV prototype and release packaging
body: Enforces the exact prototype keys required by runtime and adds a checksum/provenance release packager for a future validated checkpoint. It does not fabricate or publish model metrics.

title: Add reproducible real Gemini evaluation runner
body: Adds a key-from-environment-only runner for the fixed LLM scenarios. It writes real outputs and latency to a separate artifact while preserving manual-review gates before metrics can be published.

title: Align final docs with verified Railway IPv6 state
body: Updates the secure persistence runbook to use the now-verified ReturnReview API outbound IPv6 path to Supabase direct Postgres. No secret values or runtime changes are included.

title: Add safe public segmentation converter
body: Adds a polygon-only converter for licensed YOLO instance-segmentation exports. It refuses detection-box rows and preserves provenance in a generated manifest. Public data remains supplemental to the controlled real pilot.

title: Add secure activation and controlled pilot plan
body: Reduces the final manual work to two deterministic tasks: secure dashboard activation for Postgres/Gemini and a balanced 28-image real pilot with a machine-validated manifest. No secrets or fabricated data are added.

title: Add ReturnReview submission and viva pack
body: Prepares the non-fabricated academic deliverables around the implemented architecture: final report draft, presentation structure, viva revision sheet, and screenshot checklist. Real metrics/screenshots remain explicitly gated on real CV/Gemini artifacts.

title: Add finalization and fixed LLM evaluation readiness
body: Closes code-only finalization gaps without fabricating results: adds a fixed LLM evaluation scenario set + validator, a truthful release-readiness checker, finalization documentation, and checklist/evaluation updates. Actual Gemini/CV metrics remain blocked on real secrets/data/artifacts.

title: Add fixed Gemini evaluation protocol
body: Adds fixed structured-evidence LLM cases, a real Gemini tool-calling runner, manual-review gating for final metrics, and documentation. This evaluates the LLM layer independently of CV training and refuses unreviewed outputs as final metrics.

title: Add dataset provenance and segmentation validation
body: Adds a vetted public-source provenance registry, strict single-class YOLO-seg dataset validation, and explicit rules preventing detection boxes or ambiguous labels from being treated as segmentation ground truth. No model metrics are fabricated.

title: Add durable persistence and production readiness
body: Adds PostgreSQL/Supabase persistence support with DB-backed evidence media, a readiness endpoint, SQLite backward migration, isolated Supabase App 13 migration/runbook docs, updated governance state, and regression tests. Production remains on SQLite until the dedicated return_review_backend credential/URL is set securely.

title: Enforce Railway governance contract in CI
body: Adds a fail-closed CI gate requiring README.md, AGENTS.md, and RAILWAY_HUB_RULES.md to remain present and linked to the canonical Railway Project Hub.

title: Finalize Railway Hub cleanup state
body: Updates ReturnReview's Railway governance document to reflect that the duplicate MotionLab service and old embedded Hub metadata have both been safely removed. Documentation only.

title: Add Railway Project Hub governance
body: Adds Railway Hub safety rules, extends AGENTS.md for Railway scope, and links the governance contract from README. No application logic, secrets, or runtime resources changed.

title: Document verified live deployment
body: Updates README/checklist/deployment docs to match the actual hosted state: isolated Railway web+API services, persistent ReturnReview-only volume, production CORS, read-only Project Hub audit, and the exact remaining CV/Gemini blockers.

title: Add isolated hosted frontend container
body: Adds a standalone Next.js production container, points the hosted build at the ReturnReview Railway API, and adds a Docker boot/HTTP smoke test. This enables an isolated Railway frontend fallback without touching any existing Vercel project.

title: Add multi-view aggregation and verification evaluation
body: Adds conservative case-level multi-angle defect aggregation, validation-only threshold calibration for OpenCLIP category verification, held-out verification accuracy/FAR/FRR evaluation, and aggregation tests. No metric values are fabricated.

title: Add Railway backend deployment container
body: Adds a minimal production Dockerfile for the FastAPI backend, deployment documentation, and a CI container build. The hosted skeleton deliberately excludes the untrained CV stack and uses no Supabase resources.

title: Add pilot dataset readiness tooling
body: Adds a non-destructive pilot image audit (quality, exact/near duplicates, filename metadata) plus leakage-safe train/validation/test manifests grouped by physical box/session. No data, model, Supabase, or deployment state is modified.

title: Add Project Hub safety contract
body: Adds the two repository-side safety files required by Project Hub before any ReturnReview database resource can ever be created. No Supabase write or schema change is included.

title: Build ReturnReview MVP foundation
body:
## What this establishes

- Next.js evidence-focused reviewer UI
- FastAPI case/upload/review/decision API
- local SQLite + file storage for safe early development
- YOLO11n-seg binary damage adapter
- OpenCLIP product verification + prototype-based few-shot defect recognition
- Gemini read-tool review agent + deterministic fallback
- deterministic grounding guard
- human reviewer corrections, notes and audit timeline
- strict case-state transitions
- real IoU/Dice/F1 evaluation tooling
- request IDs, latency/error logging
- GitHub CI and project documentation

## Academic boundary

**CV observes → policy/database provides facts → LLM interprets → human decides.**

No CV evidence is fabricated when a trained checkpoint/prototype bank is missing, and evaluation pages do not invent metrics.

## Data safety

Supabase is intentionally untouched. ReturnReview stays on local persistence until the shared Project Hub Supabase README and existing schema are inspected read-only.

## Remaining real-world dependency

Pilot cardboard-box photos → mask annotation → model training/calibration → held-out metrics → production deployment.
